summary: AsiaStrategy (Nasdaq: SORA) filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, announcing entry into a Bitcoin-collateralized credit facility with an institutional counterparty in Asia, where AsiaStrategy acts as lender. The facility is multi-tranche, with draws at the counterparty's election but subject to AsiaStrategy's discretion, generating recurring revenue and reducing reliance on equity issuance. Terms are not disclosed. Separately, the company is formulating an M&A strategy but has not agreed to any transaction. This is an ordinary business update; no specific pending transaction or special-situation event is announced.
